Phase 5: plan sets RuleSpec.ruleAxioms densityRule/z1Rule to []. GATE 3 (ruleAxioms_covers_ruleFrameClass, proved by decide) requires a rule gated above .Base to name an axiom at exactly its frame class, so [] fails the build for those two.
